_about: Sample results for the demo claims in demo/demo-page.html. Used ONLY in demonstration mode, and always shown with the 'Demonstration data' label. Each 'claim' must match the claim text on the demo page (a partial selection of it also matches). If the team replaces a claim on the page, replace it here too. Source links are real home pages, with no invented deep links.

claims.claim: Boiled guava leaves can cure dengue.

response.information_status: Limited or No Strong Supporting Evidence
response.analysis_paragraph: There is no medical proof that boiled guava leaves can cure dengue. Dengue is a serious illness that requires proper medical care and monitoring. Some sources mention that guava leaves may have general health benefits, but they are not recognized as a treatment for dengue. Relying only on home remedies can be dangerous and may delay proper treatment.

sources.title: Research Institute for Tropical Medicine (sample source)

claims.claim: The city government announced that classes will be suspended on Friday because of heavy rain.

response.information_status: Recent or Not Yet Widely Confirmed
response.analysis_paragraph: This reads like a news announcement about class suspensions. Announcements like this change quickly, and we could not find several independent reports that confirm it yet. Please check the official page of the local government and a weather advisory before relying on it.

claims.claim: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.

response.analysis_paragraph: This is a well-known scientific fact, and it is widely documented. At standard sea-level pressure, pure water boils at 100 degrees Celsius. The boiling point is lower at higher altitudes because the air pressure is lower.

sources.title: National Institute of Standards and Technology (sample source)

claims.claim: Ang Bulkang Mayon ay isa sa mga pinakaaktibong bulkan sa Pilipinas.

response.analysis_paragraph: This Filipino statement says that Mayon Volcano is one of the most active volcanoes in the Philippines. Volcano monitoring agencies and volcano databases describe Mayon as one of the country's most active volcanoes. For current activity updates, please check the official volcano bulletins.

sources.title: Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (sample source)

claims.claim: Mas healthy daw ang brown rice kaysa sa white rice dahil mas marami itong fiber.

response.analysis_paragraph: This Taglish statement says brown rice is healthier than white rice because it has more fiber. Brown rice does keep more fiber than white rice, which is supported. Whether it is healthier overall depends on a person's diet and health needs, so the claim is only partly supported. A nutrition professional can give advice that fits you.

sources.title: Food and Nutrition Research Institute (sample source)
